checks.name: Multiplicity-three critical point and complete length-three chain
checks.detail: For sites (1,−1,i,−i), all four Hamiltonians satisfy the exact Taylor-chain polynomial relations. The uniform vector plus V₀,V₁,V₂ has rank4. On the highest-weight plane N²≠0 and N³=0; the full characteristic polynomial is (λ−3/4)(λ+1/4)³.

checks.name: Closed characteristic formula and fractional-linear Hamiltonian identities for four sites
checks.detail: Exact Gaussian-rational evaluation verifies χ_Hi(λ)=u^n p′(z_i+1/u)/p′(z_i) at the base site. All A_j[I+(z_i−z_j)A_i]=A_i identities hold with invertible denominators.

checks.name: Mixed multiplicity example with exact characteristic factorization
checks.detail: For eight sites ±1,±i,±2,±2i, the multiplicity-three chain is checked for every Hamiltonian. An independent Newton/trace computation of the full H₁ characteristic polynomial exactly matches the stated cubic factor times four distinct regular-root factors and the uniform factor. All Hamiltonians commute.

checks.name: Closed characteristic formula and fractional-linear identities in the mixed case
checks.detail: The general characteristic-polynomial formula independently reproduces the full degree-eight polynomial, and all eight Hamiltonian fractional-linear relations have exactly invertible denominators and zero residual matrices.

scope: Every calculation here is exact in Q(i). The arbitrary-n classification and the squarefreeness criterion are proved in S014; they are not inferred from these examples.
